question: Sohan introduces a man: "He is the only son of my mother's only son." How is the man related to Sohan?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Given: 

Statement: "He is the only son of my mother's only son."

"My mother's only son" → Sohan himself (assuming Sohan is the only son).

"The only son of my mother's only son" → Sohan’s son.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9fc797ba7cf3409736a6bfb8c9a8711c259911018146ed057ad9bdf9d3fa6e96.png] 

So, the man is **Sohan’s son**.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
